author: Julius Gavroche
title: Giorgio Agamben: State and anomie II
content:
Luca Signorelli, The Devil whispers to the Antichrist; detail from 

Sermons and Deeds of the Antichrist

, 1499-1504


If we refer to the doctrine set out in Paul’s second letter to the Thessalonians, we can then say, as we have already done in this section, that the

katechon

—the power that restrains and delays the end, which the Church Fathers identified with institutions (the Roman Empire and the Church itself)—is today in crisis everywhere, and we are witnessing, therefore, the advent of the

anomos

, a lawless power that brings ruin and proclaims itself to be God (which is why the Church Fathers identified it with the Antichrist).


This is evident in the United States, where institutions no longer seem to function and all power lies in the hands of a man who speaks and acts without any regard for the law (the same can be said of Israel) and masquerades as God. It is worth reflecting on this epochal situation, which involves the whole of the West. Given that institutions (the State and its historical structures) have lost all credibility, it is futile to base upon them the power that holds back the eschatological event. And this is all the more true insofar as

anomos

, the lawless one, is not an external principle, but rather the form that the institution itself assumes as it decays. Trump and Netanyahu do not come from outside: it is the State itself—the power that ought to hold back and delay the end—that becomes the agent which accelerates and precipitates it in its most ruinous forms.


Quodlibet

, 27 July, 2026

author: M.P
title: Lof Winkül Küsra convoca a apoyar audiencia en Juzgado de Osorno
content:
El Lof Winkül Küsra convoca a apoyar nueva audiencia a realizarse el día lunes 3 de agosto a las 10 horas, en el Juzgado de Garantía de Osorno, ubicado en calle Los Carrera 1400 (altura terminal de buses) en Osorno.

Mari mari monkü ta che fillke Mapu tayin Willimapu mo. Mari mari monkü pu wüenenkeche, chumüechi pu Apo ülmen, pu Lonko, pu Machi, pu Lawentujo, pu Nguillatujo, pu Wünen Srütrü, pu Kona, pu Aukafo, pu peñi ka pu lamüen ka chilenos consientes.

Nuestro Lof Winkül Küsra convoca a las comunidades, pu lof, pu nguillatun y organizaciones Mapuche Williche y defensores de los derechos humanos a acompañarnos este lunes 3 de agosto, a las 10:00 horas, en el Juzgado de Garantía de Osorno, donde se realizará una nueva audiencia en el marco del proceso judicial relacionado con nuestra reivindicación territorial.

Como comunidad, reafirmamos que nuestra demanda responde a lo que consideramos nuestro derecho ancestral sobre un territorio que forma parte de nuestra historia, memoria e identidad como pueblo Mapuche Williche. Confiamos en que la justicia valorará todos los antecedentes con imparcialidad y reiteramos que ejerceremos nuestra defensa por las vías legales.

Agradecemos el apoyo y la solidaridad de quienes nos han acompañado durante este proceso. Su presencia será una importante muestra de respaldo.

Por nuestro territorio, nuestra memoria y las futuras generaciones.

author: rezgar2
title: اليسار واختراق القلعة الرقمية للرأسمالية
content:
ومن دون حضور يساري فاعل وعمل مشترك بتنسيق أممي في هذا المجال، ستستمر الرأسمالية الرقمية في تحديد اتجاه التطور التكنولوجي بما يخدم مصالحها الخاصة، وتتحكم بمستقبل البشرية. وفي نهاية المطاف، تكمن قوة اليسار الفعلية في قدرته على دمج التنظيم البشري الميداني مع التفوق الرقمي، ليكون الفضاء الرقمي ساحة داعمة وفعالة، لا بديلاً عن النضال، وإنما جناحاً يحلق به نحو مستقبل اشتراكي إنساني وأكثر عدلاً.

من الصعب خوض معركة التحرر الاشتراكي في القرن الحادي والعشرين بأدوات القرن الماضي. ففي زمن تهيمن فيه الخوارزميات، ويتسع فيه تأثير الرقمنة والذكاء الاصطناعي على الإعلام والثقافة والتعليم والعمل والحياة اليومية، وتصاغ السياسات والاستراتيجيات الاقتصادية عبر تحليل البيانات الضخمة وحوسبة القرار السياسي والاقتصادي، يجد اليسار نفسه أمام تساؤل وجودي: كيف يمكن لحركات ما زالت تعمل وتنظم نفسها بمنطق تقليدي أن تصمد أمام رأسمالية رقمية بلغت من التقدم التكنولوجي حداً غير مسبوق؟

إن استمرار التنظيمات اليسارية في الاعتماد على أساليب تقليدية في الخطاب والتنظيم والعمل يضعها أمام تحدٍ كبير في مواجهتها مع الرأسمالية. فنحن نواجه خصماً يمتلك ترسانة متطورة من الأدوات الرقمية والاقتصادية والسياسية والعسكرية والإعلامية، ويتطور على مدار الدقيقة في كافة المجالات، ويتكيف مع أزماته رغم عمقها، ويتحالف طبقياً مع بعضه رغم الصراعات بين كتله، في حين لا يزال جزء غير قليل من اليسار يعتمد على منهجيات ووسائل قديمة لم تعد تواكب متطلبات هذه المواجهة المتجددة. وهذا ما نشهده اليوم على أرض الواقع، وهو ما يجعل الحاجة إلى تطويرها وتجديدها أكثر إلحاحاً من أي وقت مضى.

وفي مقالات سابقة، عبرت عن هذه الفجوة الرقمية الكبيرة بتشبيه الفيل والنملة. غير أنه بعد هذا التطور المتسارع والهائل الذي بلغته الرأسمالية الرقمية، وفي ظل محدودية البدائل الرقمية اليسارية والتقدمية المؤثرة، وبحكم عملي المهني في مجالات الخوارزميات والحوكمة الرقمية، أرى أن هذه الفجوة قد اتسعت الآن لتصبح بين النملة والديناصور. إنه واقع صعب ومر لا بد أن نقر به بصراحة، لكي نبدأ من هذا الإقرار في التفكير الجاد بالبدائل الممكنة.

شكل العلم والتكنولوجيا محوراً أساسياً في فكر كارل ماركس وفريدريك إنجلز، إذ رأيا فيهما أدوات قابلة للاستخدام في التحرر أو في تعزيز الهيمنة الطبقية. ففي ظل الرأسمالية، يسخر التقدم العلمي والتكنولوجي لتعظيم أرباح البرجوازية واستغلال شغيلات وشغيلة اليد والفكر، مما يفاقم الاغتراب والتفاوت الطبقي. غير أن ماركس وإنجلز أدركا أن هذه التناقضات تحمل إمكانيات ثورية قد تسهم في بناء نظام اشتراكي أكثر عدلاً. واليوم تبدو رؤيتهما أكثر إلحاحاً في عصر الرأسمالية الرقمية، حيث تحولت التكنولوجيا إلى وسيلة جديدة للسيطرة، مع أنها تحمل أيضاً فرصاً لتحرير البشرية.

فإدراكهما العميق للطبيعة الجدلية للتاريخ والمجتمع جعلهما ينظران إلى التقدم العلمي باعتباره قوة مادية واجتماعية تعكس علاقات القوة الطبقية، وسلاحاً ذا حدين يحمل إمكانيات تحريرية هائلة، ويستخدم في الوقت ذاته لتعميق الاستغلال وترسيخ الهيمنة الرأسمالية. وقد كان فكرهما شاهداً على قدرة التحليل المادي على دمج العلم مع النضال الطبقي، حيث تصبح المعرفة قوة دافعة لتغيير العالم، لا مجرد وسيلة لفهمه. إن مشروعهما الفكري يدعو بوضوح إلى تجاوز حدود النظام الرأسمالي نحو مستقبل أكثر إنسانية، مستنداً إلى الإمكانيات التحررية التي يتيحها التقدم التقني.

في تحليل ماركس للرأسمالية، احتلت التكنولوجيا موقعاً مركزياً في كشف التناقضات الجوهرية للنظام. فرأى أن الماكينات، التي مثلت قمة التقدم العلمي في عصره، لم تكن أدوات لتحسين حياة البشر أو تحريرهم من أعباء العمل الشاق، وإنما غدت وسائل فعالة لمراكمة أرباح الرأسماليين وزيادة استغلال شغيلات وشغيلة اليد والفكر. وأدى هذا التوظيف للتكنولوجيا إلى إنتاج فائض القيمة عبر تقليل الحاجة إلى العمل البشري، تاركاً البروليتاريا في حالة اغتراب، حيث يفصل العامل عن عملية الإنتاج ونتائج عمله. ولم يكن هذا التناقض عرضياً عند ماركس، إنما كان جزءاً جوهرياً من آليات الرأسمالية التي تجعل من العلم والتكنولوجيا أدوات للسيطرة الطبقية.

أما إنجلز، فقد نظر إلى العلم كأداة لفهم الصراع الاجتماعي بعمق أكبر. وقد جعله تأثره بالاكتشافات العلمية يرى أن الصراع لا ينحصر في المجتمع الإنساني، إذ يمتد أيضاً إلى الطبيعة. غير أنه رفض الحتمية البيولوجية، مؤكداً أن القوانين الحاكمة للطبيعة تختلف عن القوانين الاجتماعية التي تتأثر بالعمل الإنساني الواعي. وأضاف إنجلز بعداً علمياً للمادية الجدلية، حيث أظهر أن قوانين الديالكتيك تنطبق على الطبيعة والمجتمع، مما يعزز فهم التحولات التاريخية كجزء من حركة تطورية شاملة.

وهذا النهج في مراجعة النظرية على ضوء التحولات التاريخية لم يكن غريباً عن ماركس نفسه، فقد أقر هو وإنجلز صراحة، في مقدمتهما المشتركة للطبعة الألمانية من البيان الشيوعي الصادرة في لندن عام 1872 ، أي بعد أربعة وعشرين عاماً من صدور البيان الأصلي، بأن مبادئه العامة ما زالت صحيحة في مجملها، غير أن بعض تفاصيله العملية، وتحديداً البرنامج الثوري المطروح في ختام الفصل الثاني، قد شاخ وبات يحتاج صياغة مختلفة تماماً، وذلك في ضوء التطور الصناعي الهائل الذي شهده العالم منذ 1848، وتوسع التنظيم …

AK Press in 2009 published James Horrox’s A Living Revolution: Anarchism in the Kibbutz Movement, an examination of European anarchism’s influences on Zionist settler colonialism in Palestine that aspires to locate anarchism in Israeli kibbutzim. His efforts instead expose failures of the European Left canons, a misstep from a respected Left publisher, and a willingness to embrace colonial violence and anti-semitism if it can be read as vaguely anarchistic.

Horrox’s text contains numerous factual errors as when he writes that Bar Giora “grew out of an organization known as the Hashomer” (p.20) and not the other way around. These inaccuracies are less a problem than how Horrox immediately follows writing Hashomer’s “members were, from an early stage, ‘motivated by a conviction that the commune was the best way of life for themselves and their families.’ The group developed an ‘alternative model based upon cooperative settlement,’” (p.20) without noting Hashomer’s primary motivation was establishing settler relations of force to create a racialized labor caste of colony guards. Their idea of a “commune” was explicitly defined as one without Palestinians. Horrox’s idealized spaces are settler sovereignties created through and in order to extend ethnic cleansing.

Horrox notes in the introduction that “Many see the kibbutz’s very existence as predicated on the forcible displacement and subjugation of the region’s native Arab population, and would consider any progressive ideals of equality and social justice that the kibbutzim profess to hold nullified by the massive inequality on which the practical manifestation of these ideals has come to be based,” [emphases in original] (p.8-9). He immediately dismisses the harm kibbutzim enact writing, “Throughout history, all projects attempting to self-organize have been caught in different types of power networks that have complicated their existence. The kibbutz is no different,” (p.9). Horrox doesn’t elucidate which projects he is talking about but surely not all of them create the “power networks” that othered populations are then “caught in”. It’s telling that Horrox cites Gershon Shafir’s 2002 work (with Yoav Peled) Being Israeli but not his celebrated 1989 text Land, Labor and the Origins of the Israeli-Palestinian Conflict that directly contradicts Horrox’s thesis about socialist ideologies being the driving factors in the Zionist settler colonial forms of the kibbutz and moshav. Horrox contradicts himself, seemingly without knowing, throughout the text on this. “In 1909, a strike broke out when Kinneret’s Jewish workers decided they could no longer put up with the oppressive, arbitrary administration,” which sounds like something we hope anarchists would do. The sentence continues, “and the use of hired Arab labor,” (p.17). Oops. Doesn’t seem so anarchistic now. Settlers refusing to share the same labor fields as Palestinians is the point of Avoda Ivrit (Hebrew labor). Because Palestinian laborers had lower costs of living due to kinship …

author: admin
title: Iceland’s Last Fur Farm Raided!
content:
[The Press Office has not received any anonymous communiques about the action.]

Iceland’s last remaining fur farm was raided and at least 1,000 mink were liberated. According to media sources, investigators suspect the farm may have been broken into and that more than 1,000 animals may have escaped.

Mink escaped from the Dalsbú fur farm in Mosfellsdal, Iceland early this morning. Police received a report of the incident shortly after 7 a.m. In a statement, police said the investigation is in its early stages.

The owner of the farm explained that it would’ve taken about two hours to release the mink (8,000 of the 12,000 in the farm) and that due to loss of breeding records, the raid has had a devastating impact.

He also called the activists ‘terrorists’, especially ‘terrorists for the animals’ as ‘they have caused enormous suffering to the mink’.

May the mink (and the raider!) run fast and free!

author: By Phil Mandelbaum, Contributor
title: Reporting from Gaza with Palestinian Poet Ahmed Sarsour
content:
“It’s not just about what’s happening in Palestine, it’s happening everywhere. The same forces that are controlling the world, the capitalist and imperialist forces, they are the ones who started the war in Sudan, and they are the ones waging wars in communities in every country in the world, like in Congo and Turtle Island, and Cuba and Venezuela,” Ahmed Sarsour tells me.


It’s the afternoon of Friday, June 26, and Sarsour is struggling to stay on the call amid interruptions in electricity. The 33-year-old Palestinian poet is speaking to Unicorn Riot from his birthplace, his grandparents’ home in the center of Gaza in the city of Deir Al-Balah. Shaken but still standing after three separate bombings, the house sits adjacent to rubble from their neighbors’ former home. The local mosque has also been destroyed.


Ahmed Sarsour


“The Internet is not stable, there’s just a local vendor here in the Gaza Strip — and we are dependent on it because there hasn’t been electricity in Gaza since the seventh of October,” Sarsour says.


On October 7, 2023, Israel declared war, launching an attack on Gaza that has left the majority of Gaza’s 2.3 million people displaced. According to the official numbers reported

nearly 75,000 Palestinians have been killed

 while researchers find the total could be

fifty percent higher

 with a death toll

surpassing 100,000

.


Unicorn Riot coverage from the frontlines in Gaza and Palestine


During our conversation, Sarsour mentions October 7 repeatedly, always to assert that “the genocide” didn’t begin that day.


Sarsour was born in Palestine to a gynecologist father and pharmacist mother. When he was nine, he and his four siblings followed their parents to Sudan. It was only supposed to be for a few years, while his father finished his studies, but the family decided to stay because for them Sudan represented “the best shot to have a better life, a good life.” As Sarsour explains, “Gaza has always been this rough.”


During this time, all the Sarsour children earned their degrees; the two brothers became engineers, and their sisters doctors.


Unfortunately, though, after two decades the family was forced to return to Palestine, “fleeing the war” in Sudan that started April 2023. “We tried to hold our ground and stay there because we built a life for almost 20 years there. We had everything there, and we left everything behind,” Sarsour tells me. “And we actually fled a war to get trapped in another genocide.”


Related:

‘Zaghrouda’ in the Midst of the Sudan War


When Sarsour first returned to Palestine, he focused on his family’s survival. Friends from Sudan contacted him in February 2024, asking why he hadn’t left. But he’d only recently returned, and the family couldn’t afford to leave. So, his friends started a GoFundMe page for the Sarsours — and, at least initially, the poet Sarsour was hopeful.


It didn’t last long.


Social media users were calling Palestinians with fundraisers

spammers

 and “profiteers who are trying to scam people.” So, Sarsour decided, “I need to put a face to the campaign.”


This is when, overcoming social anxiety, Sarsour took to social media in hopes of connecting with activists and influencers online, at which point he says he “started seeing the news.” And this is when he decided poetry was the way he’d respond.


“I had been seeing what’s happening in the north, what’s happening in the south, and it broke my heart, seeing all of these people getting murdered, and getting amputated, and no one cares about them… And they were recording themselves to the outside world to see, and yet people were calling them liars.”


“They always claim that these are Hamas members or terrorists, but even after the claimed ceasefire, these targets have been intensified,” he says. “And they are trying to target people during the most uncommon times, when they don’t expect it… During weddings, or festivities, or in the markets.”


Another example, Sarsour adds, is the targeting of fishermen — because “they don’t want Gazans to have any reliable source of food.”


Before returning to Palestine, Sarsour had written poems about the wars there “in 2012, 2014, 2018 and 2020, and all the other wars they waged in Gaza.” He’d written in his native language, Arabic, from his home in Sudan. And then for five years he didn’t write at all, feeling “really betrayed because no one cares, no one is listening.”


Coming “face to face” with the destruction is what made him realize …

author: CNT Iruña
title: Ciclo Cultural Popular de Agosto
content:
CNT Iruñea presenta para el mes de agosto un ciclo cultural popular, que constará de la proyección de varias obras de carácter cinematográfico, así como de un día de micrófono abierto. Los diferentes eventos se celebrarán en el local del sindicato e irán acompañados tanto de una introducción previa como de un coloquio posterior.


Bajo el nombre de Ciclo Cultural Popular, CNT Iruñea quiere ofrecer un espacio de cultura y ocio libre para todas aquellas personas de la clase trabajadora que se ven obligadas a permanecer en la ciudad durante el verano. Siguiendo la estela de ateneos libertarios, universidades populares y las diversas formas de difusión pedagógica de la tradición anarquista, CNT continúa, así, desarrollando los valores que, en cuanto institución de clase, se sostienen con quienes merecen el descanso y un lugar donde tomar un breve respiro para el intercambio de ideas antes de seguir con la lucha por la emancipación social.


Los eventos, fechas y horarios son los siguientes:


Sábado 1 · 11:30:

 

Dellamorte Dellamore

 (Michele Soavi, 1994) · Película


Francesco Dellamorte es el cuidador del cementerio de Buffalora, un pueblo del norte de Italia. Dellamorte vive una vida solitaria apartado del mundo; su único amigo es Gnaghi, un pequeño, feo, lisiado y mudo compañero con el que comparte su ronda diaria por el cementerio. Desde hace algún tiempo, los muertos enterrados en el cementerio de Buffalora reviven debido a una súbita y misteriosa epidemia.


Miércoles 5 · 19:00:

 

Italian Punk Hardcore 1980-1989 

(Angelo Bitonto, Giorgio S. Senesi, Roberto Sivilia, 2015) Documental


Los orígenes del punk hardcore en Italia. Ciudades y centros neurálgicos. Autogestión, centros ocupados, política. Autoproducción, casetes de cinta y discos de vinilo. Los sellos independientes. Fanzines y boca a boca. Conciertos, manifestaciones, eventos. Los enfrentamientos, la violencia, los excesos, las drogas. La relación conflictiva entre el punk y la prensa, los periódicos y las revistas. El comienzo, el pico y el declive de las grandes bandas de los 80.


Sábado 8 · 11:30:

 

Vivir la utopía

 (Juan A. Gamero, 1997) · Documental


La historia de movimiento anarcosindicalista en el Estado Español desde sus primeros atisbos, a finales del XIX, hasta el final de la guerra civil: la creación de la CNT y la FAI, el papel de la cultura y la educación con la Escuela Moderna, la explosión de ideas y la actividad que supuso la llegada de la II República, el golpe militar y, a la vez, la Revolución Social. Con el testimonio de hombres y mujeres anarquistas que vivieron aquella experiencia única.


Sábado 15 · 11:30:

 S

lave to the Grind

 (Doug Robert Brown, 2018) · Documental


El grindcore es la música más intensa, agresiva y rápida del mundo. Al fusionar las actitudes anarquistas e izquierdistas de la escena punk del Reino Unido con la velocidad y la agresión ebria del death metal estadounidense, el grindcore continúa desafiando a la mayoría de los oyentes.


Miércoles 19 · 19:00:

 

El tiempo de los obreros

 (Stan Neumann, 2020) · Documental


Serie de cuatro documentales independientes, encadenados cronológicamente, que repasa la historia de la clase trabajadora en Europa desde principios del siglo XVIII hasta la actualidad.


Miércoles 26 · 19:00:

 

Micrófono abierto


Trae tu poesía, reflexiones, música (con tus instrumentos), monólogos, microrrelatos y cualquier forma de expresión que quieras compartir.


Sábado 29 · 11:30:

 

Liberation Day

 (Ugis Olte, Morten Traavik, 2016) · Documental


Este documental musical sigue la increíble historia detrás del concierto en Pyongyang de la banda eslovena de música industrial Laibach para celebrar el Día de la Independencia de la hermética Corea del Norte.


La entrada

Ciclo Cultural Popular de Agosto

 se publicó primero en

Confederación Nacional del Trabajo

author: Gaurav Kumar
title: What India’s Cockroach Party won — and what’s next
content:
This article

What India’s Cockroach Party won — and what’s next

 was originally published by

Waging Nonviolence

.


Thirty-six days after a joke about “cockroaches” became a youth movement, India’s education minister was gone. On July 25, Dharmendra Pradhan resigned after weeks of protests over failures in the public examination system and demands for political accountability. The Cockroach Janta Party, or CJP, declared victory — “Cockroaches won. Democracy won.”


For a movement that began online in May and grown into a nationwide agitation, forcing a cabinet minister from office was an unmistakable political concession. But almost as soon as the protesters packed up, the meaning of that victory became less certain.


Three days later, the movement was already threatening to return to the streets. The CJP

said

 over 100 protesters been arrested nationwide, with cases filed in the states of Delhi, Assam, West Bengal and Bihar, despite assurances that demonstrators would not face punitive action. CJP spokesperson Ashutosh Ranka warned that the agitation could resume if those arrested were not released.


Bihar police announced that the protesters had been released and would face no adverse legal action. But the assurance

did not hold in other states

, like West Bengal and Assam, where more than a dozen are still being detained.


Removing a minister was a visible symbol of accountability; ensuring that other promises made to end the protests were actually honored would require something harder — sustained organization after the crowds had gone home.


A movement that couldn’t be decapitated


When Delhi last saw a mass youth mobilization, over the

citizenship law in 2020

, the state answered by naming the organizers in a conspiracy chargesheet: Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam have now been held for more than five years under India’s

1967 anti-terror

law

 and were

refused bail again on July 4

, 16 days before the cockroaches marched on Parliament.


It began as a joke. Amidst a youth uproar over invalidated examination results, during which India’s highest judge referred to the nation’s youth as “cockroaches,” a Boston-based student from India, Abhijeet Dipke, posted on X, “What if the cockroaches marched?”


Previous Coverage


The strategic satire of India’s Gen Z ‘Cockroach’ movement


The joke carried a serious message: The protesters who turned out in response, under the banner of the Cockroach Janta Party, saw themselves as people the political system had stopped listening to.


But the Cockroach Janta Party — a parody of the Bharatiya Janata Party, or BJP, the Hindu right-wing party that has governed India since 2014 — had few of the trappings of a serious political party. There was a website where people could sign up; there was an Instagram account that had grown rapidly; and there was Dipke. By July, he was leading the sit-ins and the marches from a stage in Central Delhi — a founder the movement had acquired without ever electing one, and who insisted, along with everybody else there, that the CJP had no leader.


For five weeks, Delhi Police dealt with a protest that offered nothing conventional to target. There was no office to raid and no membership list to seize — the two things that allowed police to quell earlier movements.


So on the morning of July 18, police went for the one man everyone knew.


Sonam Wangchuk, an engineer and education reformer from the Indian Himalayas, is 59 years old and was 20 days into a hunger strike. He had lost more than 18 pounds. Police carried him from the protest site and took him to hospital.


Wangchuk had become the most recognizable face in a movement that insisted it had no leader. He runs a school in the region of Ladakh for children who struggle in India’s examination system and is a recipient of the Ramon Magsaysay Award, often described as Asia’s Nobel.


Delhi Police said they acted on a High Court order and medical advice. Protesters tried to stop officers from taking Wangchuk away, leading to what police described as a “slight commotion.”


But the police statement did not end with Wangchuk’s health. It also asked the remaining protesters to leave. They did not.


Taking a man 20 days into a hunger strike to a hospital could be explained as a medical decision. Asking everyone else to clear the square was something different.


By that afternoon the square was fuller than it had been all month, with people packed under sheets of black plastic …

author: David Swanson
title: Is the Era of U.S. Military Bases in the Middle East Over?
content:
From CENTCOM commanders to Elliott Abrams, calls are growing to rethink U.S. bases in the Middle East. Ending the war should include closing those bases.


By David Vine,

The Nation

, July 30, 2026


Their names were James Feehan, Isabella Gonzales, Michael Emmanuel Swinton, and Angel S. Rampersad. The four US soldiers, one just 19, were

killed

 amid President Donald Trump’s recent escalation of the war on Iran. Their deaths at US military bases in Jordan and Iraq highlight the vulnerability of US troops across the Middle East.


Since the

illegal

 war’s first days, US bases have suffered extensive damage from Iranian retaliation. The losses include 18 US military

deaths

,

dozens

 killed in host nations, and billions in infrastructure costs. This damage and the limited military utility of US installations are forcing a much needed reconsideration of the US military presence in the Middle East. A growing consensus finds that dramatic changes are needed.


The result will almost certainly be the end of the nearly half-century-long era when scores of US bases have occupied the Middle East. The sooner US leaders accept this reality and start moving the military out of the region, the safer our nation, our troops, and our world will be.


Base Buildup, and Vulnerability


US bases began dotting the Middle East around 1980 when Presidents Jimmy Carter and, after, Ronald Reagan started building installations in response to the Soviet occupation of Afghanistan and Iran’s 1979 revolution. More appeared during the 1991 Gulf War and the 2001 and 2003 wars in Afghanistan and Iraq. They remained long after original rationales disappeared. Today, the military has at least 80 installations in

almost every


country

 across the region.


The Iranian military has attacked most countries hosting US bases because they’ve helped enable the US–Israeli war. In addition to the human toll, damage to military infrastructure and hardware

runs

 into the

tens

 of billions of

dollars

.


US troops have been so vulnerable that military leaders

moved

 many to local hotels and offices, likely violating the laws of war. Iran has

made

 many Middle East installations “all but uninhabitable,” reports the

New York Times

.


Calls for Change


Many,

including

 former military leaders, are urging change. Current infrastructure “has become an anachronism that endangers US troops,”

writes

 one of the architects of US Middle East basing, former high-ranking George W. Bush and Trump 1.0 administration official Elliott Abrams.


Some want to “harden” installations by improving their ability to survive attacks. Others want to “disperse” troops to more locations,

especially

 those farther from Iran, including

Israel

.


Both supposed solutions would cost taxpayers tens, if not hundreds, of billions of dollars in construction and operational costs. No amount of hardening and dispersing can fully protect US troops, let alone host nations. Iran could still hit US bases farther away, Abrams acknowledges, as recent deaths and injuries in Jordan show.


Governments may refuse to host as they

increasingly


question


allowing

 US bases to occupy their territory. The US military turned hosts into

targets

 for Iran rather than offering protection, as US leaders promised.


Moving more US forces to Israel would be even more dangerous. Thousands of troops have already

moved

 there due to damage to other bases. No missile defense system, including Israel’s “Iron Dome,” can keep US troops completely safe, as recent Iranian missile and drone

strikes


demonstrate

.


Politically, Israel is increasingly isolated internationally and dramatically less popular across the US political spectrum. Expanding the US military presence would deepen US complicity in Israel’s crimes in

Gaza

, encourage more untethered Israeli

aggression

, and increase the likelihood that retaliatory attacks on joint bases draw the US into Israel’s wars.


Ending the Era


The era of US bases in the Middle East isn’t over yet. US officials have already announced contracts to

rebuild

 in Qatar.


Still, closures are inevitable, just as past empires

eventually abandoned

 bases overseas. US leaders can choose whether closures will happen through a careful process involving replacing troops with empowered diplomats or through chaos, potential military defeat, and wasted billions.

title: İsrailli aşırı sağcı Bakan'dan Filistinli kadın esire:  "Burası otel değil"
content:
İsrail’in aşırı sağcı Ulusal Güvenlik Bakanı Itamar Ben-Gvir, bir İsrail hapishanesinde alıkonulan Filistinli kadın esirin tutulduğu hücreyi bastığı anlara ait görüntüleri sosyal medya hesabından paylaştı. Görüntülerde Ben-Gvir’in, hak ihlallerini dile getiren Filistinli esirle alay ettiği görüldü.


AA'nın geçtiği habere göre, Filistinli kadın esirin temiz su ve gıdaya erişemediklerini, tıbbi tedaviden mahrum bırakıldıklarını ve ağır şartlar altında tutulduklarını belirtmesi üzerine Ben-Gvir, hücredaki bir su şişesini göstererek insan hakları ihlallerini inkar etti.


Tehditkar bir üslup kullanan İsrailli Bakan, esire yönelik

"Su var aslında, görüyorum. Ama yemeklerin iyi olması gerekmiyor. Burası otel değil. Eskiden burası bir oteldi, bugün değil"

 dedi. 


Ben-Gvir’in göreve gelmesinden bu yana İsrail hapishanelerindeki Filistinli esirlere yönelik ihlallerin sistematik olarak arttığı belirtiliyor.


İnsan hakları örgütlerinin verilerine göre İsrail cezaevlerinde 350'si çocuk, 84'ü kadın olmak üzere 9 bin 600'den fazla Filistinli esir bulunuyor. Açlık, işkence ve tıbbi ihmal nedeniyle bugüne kadar çok sayıda Filistinli esir yaşamını yitirdi.


(EMK)

title: CRISI CLIMATICA. Critiche e prospettive da un punto di vista anarchico.
content:
CLICCA QUI PER SCARICARE L'OPUSCOLO VERSIONE STAMPA_


CLICCA QUI PER SCARICARE L'OPUSCOLO IN PDF


Pubblichiamo integralmente l’opuscolo appena prodotto dal gruppo di lavoro della FAI “Azione diretta e crisi climatica”. La diffusione è più che auspicata. Buona lettura! La redazione web


Prefazione


Durante il congresso della Federazione Anarchica Italiana, tenutosi a Carrara nel 2025, si è aperto il confronto sulla tematica delle lotte ambientali. Nel corso del dibattito è emerso come il problema dei cambiamenti climatici o, meglio, della crisi climatica sia una questione che per il suo carattere globale e per le molteplici implicazioni inerenti a questioni ambientali, sociali ed economiche, non solo assume un interesse riferibile all’intero pianeta Terra ma permette di sviluppare un’analisi che, inevitabilmente, si riferisce alla complessità della società in cui agiamo.


Come gruppo di lavoro abbiamo “intrecciato” gli aspetti considerati più significativi cercando di

 evidenziare tutte le criticità che, inquadrate in un unico contesto, permettono di sostenere la tesi secondo la quale non esiste reale soluzione alla crisi climatica se non si prevede lo smantellamento dello stato e del capitalismo nelle loro articolazioni politiche, economiche e militari.


Ci siamo confrontat anche sul ruolo che la scienza gioca in questo contesto, valutando che, nella piena consapevolezza della sua non neutralità, è fondamentale denunciare le spinte tecnocratiche favorendo, invece, lo stretto rapporto con chi fa ricerca, raccoglie dati, sviluppa modelli che permettono di interpretare l’evoluzione dei fenomeni.


La scienza non è neutrale perché la sua pratica è intrinsecamente influenzata dal contesto umano, sociale, economico e culturale in cui opera

. Sebbene cerchi l’oggettività, la ricerca è orientata da scelte politiche, finanziamenti e valori di chi fa ricerca scientifica. La scienza, dunque, non opera in un “vuoto asettico”. I fatti e i dati scientifici sono “veri” ma possono essere cercati e selezionati con modalità diverse, l’applicazione e la direzione della scienza sono condizionate da tempi e finanziamenti. La stessa domanda iniziale su cui s’indaga orienta in una direzione piuttosto che un’altra.


La narrazione della scienza e di chi fa ricerca e sperimentazione come entità

super partes

 è illusoria. Il problema della responsabilità sociale della scienza è un tema che ha percorso l’arco della storia.


Einstein scrisse nella sua lettera aperta del Gennaio 1947: «(…) Noi scienziati riconosciamo la nostra ineludibile responsabilità di trasmettere ai nostri concittadini una comprensione dei fatti più semplici dell’energia atomica e le sue implicazioni per la società. In questo sta la nostra sola sicurezza e la nostra unica speranza – noi siamo convinti che una cittadinanza informata agirà in favore della vita e non della morte».


In questo senso è necessario sostenere una scienza universale aperta a tutt e svincolata dagli interessi nazionali, dal profitto dei pochi a svantaggio dei più, una scienza i cui risultati appartengano alla comunità, controllata da uno scetticismo organizzato dove le conoscenze scientifiche siano passibili di giudizio critico e ritenute valide fino a prova contraria.


Consapevoli della sua condizione di illusoria neutralità possiamo comunque sostenerla come impresa sociale collettiva. Quindi una scienza inclusiva che, pur rigorosa nell’applicazione del metodo scientifico, non si ponga come entità superiore o indiscussa “guida” ma, sostenuta e in stretta corrispondenza con la società, sia orientata verso fini positivi.


Ci è sembrato, inoltre, opportuno evitare la declinazione di genere usando l’espediente delle parole tronche, con alcune eccezioni, per favorire una lettura scorrevole e l’uso del lettore vocale.


Capitolo 1 – Cosa s’intende per cambiamento climatico?


Il cambiamento climatico si riferisce a modifiche a lungo termine nelle condizioni termodinamiche e meteorologiche della Terra. Questi cambiamenti sono in gran parte causati dall’attività umana negli ultimi due secoli, soprattutto dall’uso di combustibili fossili come carbone, petrolio e gas che immettono nell’atmosfera gas serra (come anidride carbonica e metano), che intrappolano calore e riscaldano il pianeta.


Cos’è la World Meteorological Organization?


Nata nel 1873, l’Organizzazione Meteorologica Mondiale (OMM o in inglese

World Meteorological Organization

, WMO) è l’agenzia specializzata delle Nazioni Unite …

author: Yeryüzü Postası
title: Sosyal Vektörü Kazanmak İçin 104 Adım
content:
Bu kelimeler aslında FARJ’ın Toplumsal Anarşizm ve Örgütlenme adlı eserinden gelmektedir, ancak bu düzenlenmiş ve kısaltılmış versiyon, Espesifizm Çalışmaları Merkezi’nin gelişiminde ve Militan Anaokulu ‘nun sürekliliğinde önemli bir yere sahip olan bu metne ilişkin örgütsel anlayışımızı yansıtmaktadır. Aşağıdaki paragrafları, “Okuma Rehberimiz”i sayfa numaraları ve üç nokta kullanmadan uyarlayarak, daha akıcı bir okuma sağlamak amacıyla düzenledik, numaralandırdık ve alt başlıklarla ayırdık.

Espesifizm derken, iki temel ekseni olan bir anarşist örgütlenme anlayışından söz ediyoruz: örgütlenme ve toplumsal çalışma/toplumsal eklemlenme. Bu iki eksen, anarşizmin toplumsal ve politik düzeylerde farklılaşmış eylemine dair klasik kavrama (Bakuninci eksen) ve özgül anarşist örgütlenme kavramına (Malatestacı eksen) dayanır.

Sentezcilik, içinde tüm anarşistlerin (anarko-komünistler, anarko-sendikalistler, anarko-bireyciler vb.) yer aldığı bir anarşist örgütlenme modelini savunur. Bu nedenle eleştirdiğimiz özelliklerin birçoğunu taşır. Sentezci örgütlenmeler içinde de toplumsal anarşizme bağlı ciddi militanlar bulunduğunu biliyoruz, bu yüzden eleştirilerimizin genelleyici görünmesini istemeyiz. Bu örgütlenmelerin anarşist olup olmadığını hiçbir zaman sorgulamasak da (bize göre hepsi anarşisttir), çoğu zaman bizim anarşist örgütlenmeyi kavrayış biçimimizle örtüşmezler. Espesifizm akımından gelmeyen başka anarşist örgütlenmeler de vardır. Dolayısıyla espesifizm, yalnızca anarşist örgütlenmeyi savunmaktan çok daha fazlasını ifade eder. Biz anarşizmi bir ideoloji olarak anlıyoruz; yani “eylemle doğrudan bağı olan bir fikirler, motivasyonlar, özlemler, değerler bütünü, bir yapı ya da kavramlar sistemi, bizim politik-pratik dediğimiz şey” olarak. Espesifizm, bir ideoloji olarak, günümüz toplumunu, toplumsal devrim yoluyla özgürlükçü sosyalizme dönüştürecek bir eylem modeli kurmaya çalışan bir anarşizmi savunur. Burada amacımız, bu anarşizm anlayışını; yalnızca özgür düşünmeyi teşvik eden, bir toplumsal dönüşüm modeli kurmayı zorunlu görmeyen, salt soyut ve teorik başka bir anlayıştan ayırt etmektir. Anarşizm, yalnızca yaşamı eleştirel biçimde gözlemleyen bu modelden düşünüldüğünde, estetik bir özgürlük ve sonsuz olasılık sunar. Ne var ki böyle tasarlandığında gerçek bir toplumsal dönüşüm olasılığı sunmaz, çünkü pratiğe, eyleme dökülmez. Nihai hedefleri gözeten politik pratiğe sahip değildir.

Espesifizm modelinde, faaliyetin politik ve toplumsal düzeyleri arasında zorunlu olarak bu ayrım bulunur. Böylece özgül anarşist örgütlenme, politik ve ideolojik düzeyde bir araya gelen ve asıl faaliyetlerini, mücadelenin mayası olmayı hedefleyerek, daha geniş olan toplumsal düzeyde sürdüren anarşistlerin örgütlenmesidir. Toplumsal ve politik düzey arasındaki bu ayrımı tasarlarken, bununla toplumsal hareketlerin önünde olmak istediğimizi ya da politik düzeyin toplumsal düzey karşısında herhangi bir hiyerarşiye veya tahakküme sahip olduğunu söylemek istemiyoruz. Genel olarak anarşizmde, toplumsal ve politik düzey arasındaki bu ayrım tüm akımlar tarafından kabul edilmez, bu akımlar anarşist örgütlenmeyi belirsiz bir biçimde anlarlar ve bunun bir toplumsal hareket, bir örgütlenme, bir yakınlık grubu, bir çalışma grubu, bir topluluk, bir kooperatif vb. olabileceğini düşünürler. “Örgütlenme karşıtı” ya da hatta kendiliğindenci tutumları savunan ve her türlü örgütlenme biçiminin otoriter olduğunu ya da anarşizme aykırı olduğunu düşünen anarşist akımlar da vardır. Bu görüşleri savunan ve toplumsal çalışma yapmaya istekli olan bazı anarşist bireyler, otoriter güçlerle baş edemezler ve uygun bir örgütlenme olmadan, otoriter projeler için işçi ve “kol” haline gelirler ya da toplumsal hareketlerde yer edinemedikleri için hayal kırıklığına uğrayarak ayrılırlar. Bizim anlayışımıza göre, toplumsal hareketleri ideolojikleştirmeye yönelik bu ve benzeri girişimler hem toplumsal hareketleri ki bunlar artık toprak, konut, istihdam vb. somut meseleler etrafında işlemez hale gelir, hem de anarşizmin kendisini zayıflatır, çünkü toplumsal hareketin içinde gerçekleşen ideolojik mücadelelerin derinleşmesine izin vermez. Bu aynı zamanda zayıflatır da, çünkü bu anarşistlerin toplumsal hareketlerin tüm militanlarını anarşist yapma hedefi, hareketleri ciddi biçimde küçültüp zayıflatmadıkça imkânsızdır. Böylece, ya da toplumsal hareketlerde asla anarşist olmayacak farklı ideolojilerden insanlara rastlamanın doğal olduğunu görerek, bu anarşistler hayal kırıklığına …

author: Radikal Perspektif
title: Espesifizm Nedir?
content:
Toplumsal ve Siyasi Düzey, Çifte Örgütlenmecilik ve Anarşist Örgüt


Yazan: Collective Action


Çeviren: Gorthim


Çevirilen Asıl Metin


PDF Linki


Collective Action platformu hakkında yapılan tartışmalarda bazı kişiler, kendimizi özdeşleştirdiğimiz toplumsal anarşizm geleneğini tanımlamak için “espesifizm” terimini kullanmamızdan dolayı kafa karışıklığı yaşadıklarını dile getirdiler. Aşağıda, espesifist modelin en temel kavramlarını ele alan kısa bir giriş yer almaktadır. Bu metin, Shift Magazine dergisiyle anti-kapitalist yeniden birleşme konusunda yakında yayınlanacak bir röportajdan uyarlanmıştır.


“Espesifizm”, anarşist gelenek içindeki bir örgütsel akımı ifade eder; bu akım, günümüz bağlamında esas olarak Rio de Janeiro Anarşist Federasyonu (FARJ) tarafından detaylandırılmaktadır, ancak tarihsel kökleri (diğerlerinin yanı sıra) Bakunin, Malatesta ve Makhno’nun yazılarında yatmaktadır. Birçok kişi, bu fikirleri yalnızca Makhno’nun “Liberter Komünistlerin Örgütsel Platformu” ile ilişkilendirir; ancak bunlar aslında toplumsal anarşizmin ilk örgütsel belgelerinden biri olan Bakunin’in Uluslararası Sosyalist Demokrasi İttifakı programına kadar uzanır. Espesifist çerçevenin merkezinde, anarşist faaliyetin toplumsal ve siyasi düzeylere ayrılmasına dair bir anlayış yer alır.

1

 Espesifistler, anarşist militanların örgütsel hatalarının çoğunun, toplumsal ve siyasi düzeylerin birbirine karıştırılmasından kaynaklandığını savunurlar.

Toplumsal düzey, kapitalizmin maddi ve ideolojik çerçevesi içinde var olan mücadeleler olarak anlaşılır (basit bir ifadeyle, geçim meseleleri). Bunlar, kapitalist toplumun ideolojisi tarafından büyük ölçüde belirlenecek ve esas olarak kapitalizmin mantığı içinde yer alacaktır; örneğin, emek karşılığında daha yüksek ücret talebi ya da devletten sosyal reformlar yapılması arzusu gibi. Bu mücadeleler aynı zamanda, hem karakterlerini şekillendiren hem de mücadele ruhu ve bilinç düzeylerinin iniş çıkışlarına neden olan daha geniş bir kültürel, ekonomik ve siyasi çerçeve tarafından yapılandırılacaktır; buna bir örnek, devam eden finansal krizin belirli sektörlerde ve coğrafi bölgelerde işçi sınıfı direnişinin hızlanmasına yol açmasıdır. Anarşistler, sınıf içindeki mevcut kompozisyon ve bilinç düzeyiyle doğrudan ilişkili bir şekilde bu mücadelelere dahil olmanın bir yolunu bulmalıdır. Başarılı bir katılım, hem sınıfın mevcut yapısını ve fikirlerini anlamak ve eleştirel olarak değerlendirmek için gerekli olan bir inceleme ilişkisini, hem de anarşist fikir ve yöntemleri pratik olarak şekillendirerek bunların toplumsal düzeyde mücadele edenler için mantıklı ve yararlı araçlar olarak görünmesini sağlamak için gerekli olan bir müdahale ilişkisini gerektirir.

Anarşistler ayrıca alternatif bir toplumla ilgili kendi tutarlı vizyonlarını — anarşist komünizmi — sürdürmek zorundadırlar. Bu, siyasi düzeydir. Siyasi düzey, devrimci azınlıklar tarafından toplumsal dönüşüm ve alternatif toplumlar için vizyonlar olarak ifade edilen fikri (teoriyi) temsil eder. Bu siyasi çizgi elbette statik değildir ve toplumsal düzeyle ilişkisel bir şekilde var olur. Siyasi düzey, yalnızca idealin propagandasının bir ifadesi olamaz. Anarşist komünizm, halk sınıflarının mücadelelerinden çıkarılan derslerden gelişen bir gelenektir. Siyasi düzeydeki çalışma, anarşist komünist militanların araştırmaları, öz eleştirileri ve örgütsel faaliyetleri yoluyla geliştirilir ve Spesifik Anarşist Örgütün (SAÖ) birliği ve örgütsel disiplini aracılığıyla ifade edilir. Magon’un da belirttiği gibi, toplumsal düzey devrimci militanların teorisini yönlendiren bir “pusula” işlevi görürken, siyasi düzey ise buradaki fikirlerin genel toplumsal çerçeveden bağımsız olarak savunulması ve dolayısıyla kapitalizm ile devletin arabuluculuğuna tabi olmaması bakımından toplumsal düzeyden ayrılır. Dolayısıyla siyasi düzey, devrimci fikirlerde netlik sağlarken bunu, bağımsız olan ve sınıfın bir bütün olarak sahip olduğu fikirleri temsil etmeyen azınlık örgütleri biçiminde gerçekleştirir.

Siyasi ve toplumsal düzeylere ilişkin bu anlayıştan ortaya çıkan sonuç, “çiftle örgütlenmecilik” uygulamasıdır. Özellikle, ilke açısından net bir duruşa sahip olan ve siyasi düzeyde siyasi birlik koşulları altında faaliyet gösteren anarşist gruplar (“espesifizm” terimi buradan gelmektedir), toplumsal düzeyde halk hareketlerine müdahale eder, bu hareketlerin içinde yer alır ya da bu hareketleri inşa etmeye çalışır. Bu müdahalenin amacı, anarşist cepheleri “ele geçirmek” ya …

author: Acratosaurio rex
title: El cabreo de Tomás Ibáñez
content:
Me apetecía decir algo sobre el artículo de Tomás Ibáñez de « anarquismos en la encrucijada », publicado por la prestigiosa web acracia.org por dos motivos. El primero y principal, por el cabreo que tiene Tomás, porque le llaman anarquista de despacho, alejado de la realidad, que publica artículos académicos, que quita la ilusión por la revolución y cosas de esas… Tomás, tío, si a mí me echaran esos piropos estaría hasta contento. En mis andaduras por ahí me llaman rata mercenaria bien pagá drogadicta fumada payasa ridícula que la historia me lo condenará cómo puedes ser tan imbécil hijo sin madre ,  por ejemplo, sin otro efecto que crearme una especie de risita nerviosa, tipo jíiiiijijijijí , y caminar por la calle girando continuamente para ver si me siguen.

El segundo que me gustaría comentar, es que mi tribuna es alasbarricadas.org , que los anarquistas de bien saben que a pesar de su nombre, que suena a tambor de guerra y a muerte dolorosísima, está dirigido por la Amalia, que es una reformista más gorda que la Montseny. Y por lo tanto sus lectores son más bien ácratas incultos que desconocen quién es el Tomás, y que ni siquiera intuyen quién es Liza (¿Simpson? ¿Minelli?), Embat, y los plataformistas… Que son los antagonistas tomasianos. Como Lex Luthor con Spiderman. De esta manera, poniendo estos enlaces, con la esperanza de que los sigáis, culturizo a mis posibles lectores…

El rollo que se traen entre manos esos actores, es el del postmodernismo y lo de la revolución. Empecé a escuchar esa palabra (posmoderna) en los años ochenta, y desde entonces si me preguntan si lo soy, respondo… « pos qué voy a sé, pos moelno joder ». Luego si me meto en los intríngulis, la verdad es que no entiendo ni papa de esa filosofía, así que corro un tupido velo y simplemente declaro que: Tomás, tío, no te cabrees, questoy contigo. Si hay que machacar cabezas, aquí me tienes.

No obstante añado que en pro de la objetividad, he intentado entender qué rayos es lo del anarquismo plataformista o especista o algo así… Me he leído sus análisis, y debo señalar, que en líneas generales, aunque –a diferencia de muchos textos posmodernos– se entiende lo que dicen, a los veinte párrafos de lectura, me entra un sueño invencible, incoercible, incontrolable. Lo de los análisis certeros , lo del estudio de coyuntura o como diablos se diga, lo de la recomposición de la vanguardia … Me recuerda a los buenos viejos tiempos de los setenta y los sesenta, que te pillaba un maoísta y te sonaba una chapa mientras se sentaba en el autobús en tus rodillas, sin pedir permiso. No obstante, insto a los anarquistas a que lean cualquier cosa que caiga en sus manos, por si se les ilumina algo.

El tema de fondo es el de la revolución. Yo en eso soy clásico. La revolución, digan lo que digan, no se prepara: sucede. Y casi siempre los revolucionarios del Gran Día se encuentran montando algún comité o algún contubernio. Cuando me dicen que lo del 36, que se recuerdan sus noventa años, tuvo una preparación minuciosa, me pregunto… ¿Quién escribió el puñetero manual?¿Dónde estuvo la mente preclara colocando peones? ¿Por qué en Italia triunfó Mussolini, y no Durruti?

Algún día, llegaremos a saberlo. Actualmente, hacemos lo que podemos.

¡Por el comunismo trinitario! ¡Lo que es de uno es de todos, lo que es de todos es de nadie, lo que es de nadie es de uno!

author: infolibre
title: ΡΑΟΥΛ ΒΕΝΕΓΚΕΜ: Να εξαλείψουμε την αρπακτικότητα, να ξαναγίνουμε άνθρωποι
content:
Ο εκ των φυσιογνωμιών της ελευθεριακής σκέψης και αναρχικής στάσης, όπως εκ των πρωτεργατών της Καταστασιακής Διεθνούς,

Ραούλ Βανεγκέμ

 πέθανε χθες σε ηλικία 92 ετών στη Βαρκελώνη όπου ζούσε. Από τη δεκαετία του ’60 στόχευσε κριτικά την κοινωνία του εμπορεύματος, της κατανάλωσης, του θεάματος, την αλλοτρίωση της ζωής και τις εξουσιαστικές μορφές. Οι θεωρήσεις του είχαν το αποτύπωμα στην εξέγερση του Μάη του ’68. Εμβληματικό έργο του:

Η Επανάσταση της Καθημερινής Ζωής

.


Μιλούσε για την κοινωνική απελευθέρωση με όρους αυτονομίας, αλληλεγγύης, ελεύθερης δημιουργίας, αυτοδιαχείρισης, κοινωνίας χωρίς κράτος, αγορά, εμπόρευμα, αλλά και απόλαυσης. Άλλωστε γνωστή η φράση του στη

Βίβλο των Ηδονών

: Ζωή που δεν δημιουργεί και δεν απολαμβάνει, χάνεται…

  Ένα από τα τελευταία έργα του είναι το κείμενό του:

Να εξαλείψουμε την αρπακτικότητα, να ξαναγίνουμε άνθρωποι

, απόσπασμα του οποίου παραθέτουμε:


«Η οργισμένη άρνηση ενός πολέμου που διεξάγεται εναντίον μιας ειδικά στοχευόμενης περιοχής –της Παλαιστίνης, στην προκειμένη περίπτωση– προχωρά πολύ περισσότερο από μια ειδική απόρριψη. Εκφράζει όλο και πιο ξεκάθαρα την συνολική άρνηση του πολέμου που διεξάγεται, όχι μόνο εναντίον του πληθυσμού μιας συγκεκριμένης περιοχής, αλλά και εναντίον των ανθρώπων όλων των χωρών του πλανήτη Γη. Η απόρριψη του πολέμου έχει πλέον κατανοήσει ότι, για τους άπληστους, απολυταρχικούς αυτού του Πολιτισμού, η ίδια η ζωή είναι έγκλημα. Αυτός είναι ο λόγος που οι νέες παγκόσμιες εξεγέρσεις είναι μέρος της αυτοάμυνας των ζωντανών. Σε αυτές ενσαρκώνονται τόσο η θέληση για κατάργηση ενός σύμπαντος ψυχοπαθών που καθιστούν τον θάνατο μηχανισμό κερδοφορίας όσο και η εφαρμογή μιας νέας συμμαχίας που η φύση της είναι να θρέφει και να φροντίζει.»


Στη Ρόζα Νέρα το 2013


Ο Βανεγκέμ είχε επισκεφθεί αρκετές φορές την Ελλάδα και συμμετείχε σε εκδηλώσεις υποστήριξης ελεύθερων κοινωνικών εγχειρημάτων, όπως στη Ρόζα Νέρα, το Νοσότρος, το Εμπρός.

Στη Θεσσαλονίκη το 2010 στο Φεστιβάλ Άμεσης Δημοκρατίας που διοργάνωνε η Αντιεξουσιαστική Κίνηση

. Ένα κατάμεστο αμφιθέατρο στη Νομική σχολή τον περίμενε για να μιλήσει και όταν αναγγέλθηκε… δεν εμφανίστηκε. Παρέμεινε καθισμένος κάπου μέσα στον κόσμο και αντ’ αυτού διαβάστηκε κείμενό του που έγραψε για την περίσταση, με τίτλο:

Το κράτος δεν είναι τίποτε, ας γίνουμε τα πάντα

, με την

επιστροφή στα βασικά

, τη χειραφέτηση του ανθρώπου και το μήνυμα:

να εγκαινιάσουμε μιά εποχή όπου ο άνθρωπος θα ξαναβρεί την αποστολή του ως στοχαστή και δημιουργού και θα ξαναγίνει αυτό που είναι και θα είναι για πάντα:

ένα ολοκληρωμένο ανθρώπινο ον

.

title: 24emîn Festîvala Çand û Xwezayê ya Munzurê dest pê kir
content:
24emîn Festîvala Çand û Xwezayê ya Munzurê, bi dirûşma "Ji bo Bîrê û Jiyana Azad Em Xwedî li Xweza, Ziman, Çand û Baweriya Xwe Derdikevin" dest pê kir. Di çarçoveya festîvalê de meşek hat li dar xistin.


Nûnerên partiyên siyasî,  saziyên civakî yên li bajêr û welatiyên ji bajarên Kurdan û yên Tirkiyeyê hatibûn, beşdarî meşa li Kolana Hunerê bûn û ber bi Qada Sêyid Riza ve meşiyan. Di meşê de dirûşmên "Dêrsim rûmet e, xwedî li rûmeta xwe derkeve", "Munzur wê azad biherike", "Gulistan Doku li ku ye?" û "Festîval a gel e, nayê bêdengkirin" hatin berzkirin û wêneyên festîvalên berê li qadê hatin daliqandin.


Pişti rêzgirtinê, li ser navê Komîteya Amadekar a Festîvalê Umît Karabulut axivî û wiha got:


“Weke beriya 26 salan, em îro dîsa hatin cem hev. Wê demê Dêrsim ji her alî ve di bin agir de bû. Ji ber vê yekê, li hember vê polîtîkayê festîval hatin destpêkirin. Ji wê rojê heta îro pirsgirêk neqediyan. Dêrsim dîsa ji her alî ve di bin zilmê de ye. Festîvala Munzurê ew e ku dîrok, bawerî û çand xwe ji nû ve ava bike. Heke em werin gel hev em ê bihêz bibin. Nexwe em ê parçe bibin.”


Piştre ji Federasyona Yekitiyên Dersîmê yên Ewropayê (ADBF) Alî Tacar axivî û ev tişt anî ziman:


“Festîval encama berhevkirineke dîrokî û wekî pêdiviyeke girseyî derket holê. Festîval ne tenê şahiyek e. Dibêjin festîval siyasi bûye. Parastina çand, ziman û baweriya me siyasetek e. Em ê rê nedin ku komeke biçûk festîvala me xira bike.”


Kordu: "Ev erdnîgarî bi têkoşîn û kedeke mezin hate hûnandin"


Di dawiyê de Parlamentera Partiya Wekhevî û Demokrasiyê ya Gelan (DEM Partî) ya Dersîmê Ayten Kordu axivî û ev tişt got:


“Ev erdnîgarî bi têkoşîn û kedeke mezin hat hûnandin. Dêrsimê ji bo hemû gelan têkoşîna azadî û wekheviyê daye. Qeyimê wê demê Tuncay Sonel li van axan jineke Kurd winda kir. Gulistan Dokû encama politîkaya ‘bêgorhiştinê’ ye. Ji bo hemû jinên hatine windakirin û qetilkirin em ê têkoşîna xwe bidomînin. Em dibînin ku tiştên ku Sonel li vir bi bikaranîna desthilata xwe kirine, nîşan didin ku polîtîkaya şerê taybet bi awayekî herî kûr berdewam dike. Li ser vê erdnîgariya qedîm, her dem êrîş çêbûn, lê Dêrsimê her dem bi hev re bûn. Ji bo eşkerebûna rastiyan, li erdnîgariya me pêdîvî bi hevrûbûnê heye. Li dijî polîtîkaya ‘bêgorhiştinê’ em daxwaza avakirina komîsyona heqîqetê dikin. Li ser rêyan, li cihên me yên pîroz kontrola nasnameyan tê kirin. Em dipirsin; hûn rêzê li kîjan heqîqetê digirin? Pêvajoyek hate ragihandin. Em ê aştiyê bi têkoşîna xwe pêk bînin.”


(AY)

title: Экономический кризис в России: «Тренды порядка и хаоса», эпизод 272
content:
Всем привет! Мы продолжаем наш еженедельный подкаст «Тренды порядка и хаоса». Это эпизод 272. Выпуск подготовил проект Antijob.net .

Скачать выпуск в виде аудиофайла

Каждую неделю мы публикуем новости об экономическом кризисе в России. Мы даже составили карту , чтобы можно было оценить масштаб проблем. Прошедшая неделя также была богатой именно на такие новости. К сожалению, по ним видно, что российское общество совершенно разучилось сопротивляться, и вместо демонстраций, забастовок и других прямых форм протеста рабочие чаще всего выбирают обращения к власти. Именно к такому способу «борьбы» прибегли работники одного из предприятий в Приморском крае.

Коллектив завода ЖБИ-3 г. Артёма обратился к Путину «за содействием и разрешением крайне тяжёлой ситуации»: руководство предприятия систематически задерживает работникам зарплату. Людям нечем кормить детей, и будущее семей рабочих – под вопросом. Кроме того, совершенно неясно будущее и самого завода.

ЖБИ-3 позиционируется как лидер на рынке Приморья по производству бетонных и железобетонных изделий. Сейчас в штате числятся около 250 человек – все они распущены по домам, поскольку завод уже долгое время находится в простое.

«Все работники находятся в абсолютном неведении, что происходит. Ситуация тревожная и непонятная», – волнуются заводчане. Они отмечают, что их проблему не могут решить ни прокуратура, ни региональная власть. По словам работников, «им больше не к кому идти» – теперь они надеются только на вмешательство Путина.

Хорошо ли, когда Путин во что-то вмешивается, теперь могут оценить большинство граждан России благодаря топливному кризису и ежедневным атакам дронов. И проблемы работников ЖБИ-3 тоже в первую очередь вызваны его «мудрой политикой». Частью экономического кризиса является кризис в строительной и смежных областях, к которым относится завод железобетонных изделий в городе Артём. Если взглянуть на нашу карту , то можно увидеть, что, помимо этого завода, также пострадал ЖБИ-100 в Барнауле и цементные заводы компании Цемрос в Белгородской, Липецкой и Ульяновской областях. Если же говорить именно о строительной отрасли, то она занимает первое место по долгам перед работниками, и на прошедшей неделе мы получили очередное свидетельство о проблемах в данной отрасли.

Один из крупнейших застройщиков Югры, группа компаний «Сибпромстрой», начала увольнять сотрудников. На заводе железобетонных изделий «ДСК-Сибпромстрой» под сокращение попали около 250 человек: среди них и рабочие, и инженеры, и ряд других сотрудников, включая руководство. Тем, кто работает на заводе по срочным трудовым договорам, по истечении срока договоры просто не продляют. Об этом сообщил совладелец «Сибпромстроя» Николай Сторожук. Причём сокращения, по его словам, коснулись не только завода.

Главная причина происходящего – резкое падение продаж жилья. Сейчас у застройщика на руках около 200 тысяч «квадратов» непроданного жилья (около трёх тысяч квартир), вскоре к ним прибавятся ещё 130 тысяч. Покупать эти «квадраты» некому: стоимость жилья для россиян стала неподъёмной, ипотека – фактически недоступной.

На этом фоне застройщик пересматривает планы по новым проектам и приостанавливает часть строек.

«На мой взгляд, такого кризиса просто не было ещё» , – комментирует Сторожук. – «Наверное, можно проводить какие-то параллели даже с 90-ми годами. Но тогда было понимание, что нужно пройти тяжёлый этап, и дальше будет развитие. Сейчас же ситуация более неопределённая».

В целом, по сообщению департамента труда и занятости населения Югры, под риском увольнения с июля по октябрь 2026 года окажутся около 1,7 тысячи сотрудников в регионе. Возможные сокращения затронут персонал 135 организаций. Уведомления о планируемых увольнениях от югорских предприятий уже поступили в департамент.

Проблемы действительно не только у строителей. Работники алтайского предприятия «Кучуксульфат» также обратились к Путину с просьбой повлиять на ситуацию с их зарплатами: руководство не проводит индексацию, и заработка едва хватает на жизнь.

АО «Кучуксульфат» – единственный в России производитель природного сульфата натрия. Это крупное градообразующее предприятие в Благовещенском районе (входит в «Росхим»), на котором трудятся около 1250 человек. Зарплату здесь в 2025 году повысили выборочно некоторым рабочим из разных цехов и начальству, а коллектив цеха № 5 (ТЭЦ) обделили полностью. Уже 1,5 года руководство обещает провести индексацию, но дальше обещаний дело не идёт.

Сейчас средняя зарплата сотрудника ТЭЦ …

author: A Melanie Lübbert
title: Gute Preise brauchen keine App
content:
Bild: Qwave CC-BY-SA 4.0 , Naturpuur CC-BY 4.0 , Bearbeitung: Melanie Lübbert

Wer eine Supermarkt-App installiert und das eigene Einkaufsverhalten erfassen lässt, bekommt oft besondere Rabatte. Wer kein Smartphone besitzt, keine App bedienen kann oder seine Daten nicht herausgeben möchte, zahlt dagegen mehr für dasselbe Produkt.

Dass es auch anders geht, zeigt Aldi. Nach eigener Aussage verzichtet das Unternehmen bewusst auf App-exklusive Rabatte. Preisvorteile sollen allen Kund.innen offenstehen – ohne Registrierung, Bonuskonto und Smartphone.

Eine von Aldi beauftragte PR-Agentur hat uns auf diese öffentliche Positionierung hingewiesen. Natürlich ist sie auch Werbung für das Unternehmen. Trotzdem ist die Entscheidung richtig. Sie zeigt, dass App-exklusive Preise keine technische oder wirtschaftliche Notwendigkeit sind.

App-Rabatte werden häufig als zusätzlicher Service dargestellt. Tatsächlich machen sie den günstigen Preis davon abhängig, ob Kund.innen ein Smartphone besitzen, eine App installieren und die Bedingungen eines Bonusprogramms akzeptieren.

Wer die technischen Voraussetzungen nicht erfüllt, Apps nicht bedienen kann oder die eigenen Einkaufsdaten nicht preisgeben möchte, zahlt mehr für dasselbe Produkt. Der reguläre Preis wird damit zum Aufpreis für Datenschutz und digitale Selbstbestimmung.

Bonusprogramme wie App-Rabatte sollen Menschen nicht nur einen Preisnachlass gewähren. Sie sollen sie an ein Unternehmen binden, ihre Einkäufe analysierbar machen und ihre Kaufentscheidungen beeinflussen.

Aus den gesammelten Daten lässt sich ablesen, wann und wo jemand einkauft, welche Produkte gemeinsam im Warenkorb landen, auf welche Rabatte die Person reagiert und wie sich ihr Einkaufsverhalten mit der Zeit verändert. Aus einzelnen Einkäufen entstehen detaillierte Profile. Unternehmen können ihre Angebote damit immer gezielter auf einzelne Personen oder Personengruppen zuschneiden.

Der Rabatt ist deshalb kein Geschenk. Kund.innen bezahlen dafür mit Daten über ihr Verhalten und ermöglichen den Unternehmen, ihre Kaufentscheidungen gezielt zu beeinflussen.

App-exklusive Rabatte sind nicht nur eine Datenschutzfrage. Sie betreffen auch die gesellschaftliche Teilhabe. Nicht alle Menschen besitzen ein aktuelles Smartphone. Manche Geräte werden von neuen App-Versionen nicht mehr unterstützt. Nicht alle Menschen können Apps problemlos bedienen. Andere möchten ihr Telefon nicht ständig bei sich tragen oder lehnen die digitale Erfassung ihres Alltags bewusst ab.

All diese Menschen müssen bei immer mehr Unternehmen für dieselben Lebensmittel mehr bezahlen. Besonders diskriminierend ist es aber für diejenigen, die ohnehin genau auf Preise achten müssen. Viele Apps setzen ein vergleichsweise aktuelles Smartphone voraus und das kostet Geld. Günstig einkaufen zu können, darf aus Sicht von Digitalcourage niemals davon abhängen, ob sich jemand ein solches Gerät leisten kann.

Für uns sind exklusive App-Rabatte deshalb ein klarer Fall von Digitalzwang. Analoge oder datenschutzfreundliche Alternativen haben jahrzehntelang funktioniert. Nun drängen Unternehmen ihre Kund.innen in Apps, weil sich dort zusätzliche Daten über ihr Einkaufsverhalten erfassen und auswerten lassen.

Digitalcourage kritisiert dieses Prinzip seit Jahrzehnten. Beim ersten deutschen BigBrotherAward im Jahr 2000 zeichneten wir das Unternehmen Loyalty Partner für die Payback-Karte aus. Schon damals galt: Wer regelmäßig persönliche Einkaufsdaten liefert, bekommt einen Rabatt. Wer das nicht möchte, zahlt mehr.

Aus der Kundenkarte von damals ist inzwischen ein ganzes Ökosystem aus Apps, Konten, Coupons und Verhaltensanalysen geworden. Das Grundprinzip ist aber gleich geblieben.

Wie viele Menschen solche Entwicklungen beunruhigen, hat unsere Petition für ein „Recht auf Leben ohne Digitalzwang“ gezeigt. Im Mai 2026 haben wir 70.111 Unterschriften gegen Digitalzwang an Abgeordnete des Deutschen Bundestags übergeben. Die zentrale Forderung lautet:

„Niemand darf wegen der Nichtnutzung digialer Zugangswege benachteiligt werden.“

Das gilt nicht nur für staatliche Dienstleistungen und öffentliche Infrastruktur. Auch Unternehmen tragen Verantwortung dafür, dass Menschen ohne Smartphone und Apps am gesellschaftlichen Leben teilnehmen können. Aldi zeigt nun, dass Preisvorteile ohne digitale Zugangshürden auch heute noch möglich sind.

Der Verzicht auf App-Rabatte macht die Aldi-App allerdings nicht automatisch datenschutzfreundlich. Laut den Datenschutzhinweisen …

author: LCM-Redaktion
title: Die schönsten Geschichten schreibt die Revolution – Über das Leben des Revolutionärs Jakow Michailowitsch Swerdlow
content:
Die schönsten Geschichten schreibt das Leben, sagt man. Woran sich aber diese Schönheit bemessen lässt? Ist sie nicht gerade Ausdruck der Vielfalt des Erlebten, die Durchdringung der einzelnen Momente und die daraus hervorschäumende Flut von Gefühlen? So zumindest wäre wahrscheinlich die Antwort eines gewissen Jakow Michailowitsch auf die Frage ausgefallen.


Von Georg Ackermann


Vor wenigen Jahren noch war mir selbst der Name „Swerdlow“ überhaupt kein Begriff. Dabei hatte ich durchaus großes Interesse an den Geschehnissen rund um die Oktoberrevolution 1917 in Russland. Viel wichtiger schien es mir jedoch aus dem ideologischen Wirrwarr unserer Tage mit der Lektüre theoretischer Klassiker zu entkommen und damit zunächst mein politisches Koordinatensystem zu ordnen. Erst die Auseinandersetzung mit der Frage, wie es überhaupt zu diesem geschichtlichen Sprung kommen konnte, legte mir den Namen Swerdlow ins Bewusstsein. Von da an begab ich mich auf die Suche nach der Geschichte eines der größten Revolutionäre, welchen die letzten Jahrhunderte und die Mühlräder welthistorischer Entwicklung hervorgebracht hatten. Nun begab es sich aber so, dass man vor ein paar Jahren lange suchen konnte, um auf deutschsprachige Aufzeichnungen von und über Swerdlow zu stoßen. Nur wenige Bücher, Hinterlassenschaften aus ostdeutschen Bücherschränken, zirkulierten von Hand zu Hand. Wer nicht gewillt war, eine Vielzahl Antiquariate auf dem Gebiet der ehemaligen DDR abzutelefonieren, wäre verdammt gewesen, lange zu warten, hätte nicht der Ceylan Verlag 2024 das Buch, in dem Jakows Lebensgefährtin, Klawdija Swerdlowa, ihre Erinnerungen niederschrieb, neu verlegt.


Erinnerungen an einen Kampfgefährten Lenins


Wenn wir uns das Leben von Jakow Michailowitsch Swerdlow vor Augen führen, so wie es im Buch geschildert wird, dann sehen wir das Lebenswerk eines Revolutionärs, dem es zwar nicht vergönnt war, besonders alt zu werden, der dafür in jeder Sekunde alle Menschen, die ihn umgeben haben, mitgerissen und das Beste in ihnen erweckt hat. Nicht umsonst trägt das Buch den Untertitel „Erinnerungen an einen Kampfgefährten Lenins“. Dieser sagte selbst über Swerdlow: „

Durch illegale Zirkel, durch illegale revolutionäre Arbeit, durch die illegale Partei, die niemand so vollkommen verkörperte und repräsentierte wie J.M. Swerdlow – nur durch diese praktische Schule, nur auf diesem Wege konnte er der höchste Repräsentant der ersten sozialistischen Sowjetrepublik, der beste Organisator der breiten proletarischen Massen werden

.“ Und so wurde Jakow im Zuge der revolutionären Umwälzungen mit gerade einmal 26 Jahren jüngstes Mitglied des Zentralkomitees der Sozialdemokratischen Arbeiter Partei Russlands und mit 32 Vorsitzender des Gesamtrussischen-Zentralexekutivkomitees. Doch dahin war es ein weiter Weg, der Jakows Charakter zu Härte schmiedete aber ihm genauso dort eine Flexibilität verlieh, wo es vonnöten war.

Während ein beachtlicher Teil der Bolschewist:innen im Zuge der Revolution von 1905 dazu verdammt war, ins Exil zu gehen, so verblieb Jakow Michailowitsch bis zur Verwirklichung der Oktoberrevolution in Russland. Dutzende Male wurde er von der Ochrana, der zaristischen Geheimpolizei, festgenommen, in den Kerker gesteckt, in die entlegensten Winkel, umgeben von endloser Taiga und Tundra verbracht und vermochte es doch unter diesen Bedingungen zu einem der wichtigsten Köpfe der Bolschewiki zu werden.

1885 in der Stadt Nischni-Nowgorod geboren, bei der sich die Oka mit der Wolga vereint, führte Jakows Weg bereits im jungen Alter in die Reihen der Sozialdemokratie, deren Organisation im zaristischen Russland mit den harten Bedingungen der Illegalität zu kämpfen hatte. Kein Geringerer als Maxim Gorki ging bei der Familie Swerdlow ein und aus. Aus Geschichten wie der des jungen Jakows nahm Gorki den Stoff, den er später in seinem berühmten Werk „Die Mutter“ zu einer Erzählung in der Person des jungen Pawel verdichtete. Jakow bahnte sich wie jener Pawel seinen Weg in die Ströme der revolutionären Bewegung selbstständig: Schnell wurden die älteren Genoss:innen des Parteizirkels in Nischni-Nowgorod auf den Jungen aufmerksam, der nicht nur die Jugendlichen um sich herum in die revolutionäre Arbeit mit hineinzog, sondern auch damit begann, sich ein umfassendes Verständnis für die philosophisch-politischen Probleme seiner Zeit zu erarbeiten. Seine Tätigkeit führte ihn, noch nicht einmal 20 Jahre alt, in die Weiten des Urals. In den Gegenden von Jekaterinburg …

author: Hassan Alnaser, Mohamed Alagra, Mashair Idris
title: Sudan Nashra: Military’s largest offensive since Khartoum brings major RSF logistics corridor in North Kordofan under its control | Military, RSF prepare detainee records in response to UN exchange initiative | IGAD reopens Khartoum office | Kiir invites Burhan to Juba summit over outstanding disputes
content:
Two days of fighting inside a

300-square-kilometer triangle i

n North Kordofan ended with the military recapturing five towns and dismantling one of the Rapid Support Forces’ most important logistics corridors, in the largest ground offensive since the military retook Khartoum last year.


The gains secured the Saderat Road linking North Kordofan with Omdurman, reopened a direct supply corridor to North Kordofan’s capital Obeid and removed one of the military’s most immediate vulnerabilities in central Sudan.


A former military officer expects the campaign to continue, saying the remaining RSF-held areas in North Kordofan and West Kordofan still serve as the group’s main supply routes from Darfur.


The military’s confidence was on display on Monday, when Transitional Sovereignty Council Chair and Sudanese military chief Abdel Fattah al-Burhan toured the newly captured towns and pledged to press the offensive westward.


Hours later, RSF Commander Mohamed Hamdan “Hemedti” Dagalo answered with a message to his own fighters, lifting restrictions on his forces’ advance and declaring a new phase of military operations.


By Wednesday, the RSF-led Tasis coalition heading the parallel government in western Sudan said the offensive has effectively ended any basis for responding to international appeals for restraint or a humanitarian truce.


What that means for recent diplomatic efforts remains unclear. It also

looms over

 one of the few developments that offered families of thousands of detainees and missing people reason for cautious hope.


A United Nations initiative to broker what could become the war’s first large-scale detainee exchange was put forward to both sides last month.


Khartoum accepted. And on Sunday, a committee established by the TSC called on families of detainees and missing persons who have not previously filed reports to register their relatives within a week, laying the groundwork for a database that would

underpin

 any future exchange.


The RSF has also begun compiling records of detainees held in areas under its control.


Yet despite the willingness shown by both sides, senior military and RSF sources told Mada Masr that any exchange would still depend on robust safeguards against military exploitation and internationally monitored transfer arrangements.


For all the tentative progress on detainees, Sudan’s political talks remain as deadlocked as ever.


A senior

African Union Commission

official said the country’s rival political forces have yet to establish even the minimum common ground required to negotiate, whether under Burhan’s planned dialogue or international sponsorship. The remark followed another unsuccessful attempt by the Quintet — made up of the AU, the UN, the Arab League the European Union and the

Intergovernmental Authority for Development

 — to convene joint talks in Addis Ababa, with the process once again splintering into separate meetings, a format another AU source described as “meaningless.”


The military’s advances in Kordofan this week, following earlier gains in Blue Nile — both bordering South Sudan — have prompted high-level outreach from Juba to try and resolve a growing list of bilateral disputes, as Khartoum can now enter talks from a stronger position, one that could allow it to impose terms with direct implications for South Sudan, a Sudanese diplomatic source said.


South Sudanese President Salva Kiir’s security affairs advisor

Tut Gatluak

arrived in Khartoum on Wednesday with a written message from Kiir to Burhan. According to Sudanese and South Sudanese diplomatic sources, Kiir invited Burhan to Juba for a bilateral summit in the coming weeks to discuss a number of unresolved issues, including border demarcation and stalled security and economic arrangements.


The talks with Gatluak turned to another sensitive issue: relations between Juba and Cairo, in which Khartoum has become increasingly entangled. Both Sudan and South Sudan have been watching the recent

cooling in ties

with growing concern, Sudanese and South Sudanese sources said. Burhan, they added, is keen to preserve stable relations with Juba, mindful that any deterioration could spill over into security along the shared border and further strain the two countries’ intertwined economies.


The day after Gatluak’s visit, Khartoum received another high-profile regional visitor.

IGAD Executive Secretary Workneh Gebeyehu

arrived in the capital on Thursday, his first visit since …

author: David Odhiambo
title: Portfolio Diplomacy: Rethinking African Economic Statecraft in a Multipolar World
content:
Walk through Nairobi and the twenty-first century global economy comes into view.


Chinese-built expressways carry commuters to office towers occupied by American technology firms. French retailer Carrefour has become one of the country’s largest supermarket chains. Japanese vehicles dominate the roads while Indian pharmaceutical companies supply hospitals and pharmacies. Increasingly, Gulf investors are financing the logistics corridors that connect Kenya to regional markets. None of these relationships is unusual on its own. Most people experience them as disconnected features of everyday life.


The Nairobi Expressway approaching Westlands. The GTC Complex, one of Nairobi’s tallest commercial developments, is visible in the background.


Yet, this is rarely the lens through which Kenya’s foreign policy is viewed. Public debate has instead become dominated by President Ruto’s extensive international travel. To supporters, those journeys reflect energetic economic diplomacy. To critics, they have become shorthand for a presidency more comfortable abroad than confronting rising taxes, public debt and domestic discontent at home.

Both perspectives, however, overlook a more important shift

.

 The debate has focused on where Kenya’s president travels rather than where Kenya’s economy is connected.


That distinction matters because the international economy that shaped African diplomacy over the past three decades is rapidly changing.


The End of the Old Development Model


For much of the post-Cold War period, African governments operated within a relatively stable political economy of development finance

.

 External capital flowed through a relatively small number of actors: Western bilateral donors, multilateral development banks and, from the early 2000s, increasingly Chinese policy banks. Diplomatic success largely meant securing access within that ecosystem.


That ecosystem is now fragmenting.

 The retrenchment of traditional development assistance provides perhaps the clearest illustration. According to the

OECD

, net official development assistance fell by 23.3 per cent in 2025 (the largest annual contraction on record) following an 8.5 per cent decline in 2024. Further reductions are projected for 2026, making this only the second time on record that ODA has declined for three consecutive years, after the period between 1992 and 1995. It’s the first time since that period that the United States, United Kingdom, Germany and France have all cut aid simultaneously.


Unsurprisingly, the sharpest reductions are expected to fall on low-income countries, with bilateral aid to sub-Saharan Africa projected to decline by as much as 28 per cent. The implication is not merely fiscal, the shrinking of aid budgets. It is structural. One of the central pillars of the post-Cold War political economy of development is becoming progressively less reliable.


A More Competitive Marketplace for Capital


Aid is only one pillar of a broader transformation.


China’s role has also evolved. The era of rapidly expanding policy-bank lending for large-scale infrastructure has given way to a more selective approach, with greater emphasis on debt sustainability, commercial viability and strategically targeted investment. Yet, this is not simply a story of one source of finance retreating. It is a story of many others emerging.


Gulf sovereign wealth funds have become increasingly important investors in ports, logistics, renewable energy and digital infrastructure. According to the

Africa Center for Strategic Studies

, the United Arab Emirates alone has announced around US$47 billion in projects across East Africa, with Saudi Arabia committing a further US$15.6 billion. Climate finance and private capital are also playing an increasingly prominent role in financing Africa’s development.


The result is a profound shift in the political economy of development: governments no longer navigate a relatively small ecosystem of donors and development banks. Instead, they operate within an increasingly competitive marketplace of capital that includes bilateral partners, sovereign wealth funds, institutional investors, multinational corporations and regional markets. In that ecosystem, diplomatic success may no longer be measured simply by how much capital a country attracts, but by how successfully it diversifies the sources from which that capital is drawn.


A Different Model of Integration
